name: Historic Centres of Berat and Gjirokastra
description: Two Albanian hill towns sit side by side in this listing. Berat, in the centre of the country, is nicknamed the "city of a thousand windows" for its tiers of white Ottoman houses climbing to a hilltop castle, which has Byzantine churches inside its walls. Gjirokastra, in the south, is a steep "city of stone" above the Drino valley, with sturdy 17th-century houses and an old bazaar.
